import json, os, ssl, uuid, urllib.request, urllib.error, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, traceback, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
base=os.environ["FHIR_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/fhir"
url=base+"/Organization/code-qa-"+str(uuid.uuid4())
# Only disposable worker-generated test keys are used; nothing leaves the VM.
container=subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","-aq","--filter","label=com.docker.compose.project="+os.environ["COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME"],"--filter","label=com.docker.compose.service=certs"],text=True).split()
assert len(container)==1, "Expected this worker's certificate container"
ctx=ssl._create_unverified_context()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as certdir:
 for name in ("server.crt","server.key"):
  subprocess.run(["docker","cp",container[0]+":/etc/openelis-global/install/"+name,certdir+"/"+name],check=True,capture_output=True)
 ctx.load_cert_chain(certdir+"/server.crt",certdir+"/server.key")
def call(method, body=None):
 data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=data,method=method,headers={"Content-Type":"application/fhir+json","Accept":"application/fhir+json"})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,context=ctx,timeout=20) as response:
  raw=response.read()
  return response.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None
suite=ET.Element("testsuite",name="isolated-fhir-roundtrip")
case=ET.SubElement(suite,"testcase",name="create_read_update_delete_organization")
failed=False
try:
 resource={"resourceType":"Organization","id":url.rsplit("/",1)[1],"active":True,"name":"code-qa synthetic before"}
 status,first=call("PUT",resource);assert status in (200,201)
 assert call("GET")[1]["name"]=="code-qa synthetic before"
 resource["name"]="code-qa synthetic after";call("PUT",resource)
 assert call("GET")[1]["name"]=="code-qa synthetic after"
 call("DELETE")
 try:
  call("GET");raise AssertionError("Deleted organization still readable")
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
  assert error.code in (404,410)
except AssertionError:
 failed=True;ET.SubElement(case,"failure",message="FHIR roundtrip assertion failed").text=traceback.format_exc()
except Exception:
 # Authentication/network/runner errors are unverified, not behavioral findings.
 failed=True;suite.remove(case);traceback.print_exc()
finally:
 try:call("DELETE")
 except Exception:pass
 Path("target/code-qa").mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 ET.ElementTree(suite).write("target/code-qa/fhir-roundtrip.xml")
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
